title: The Carolinas came together with joyfulness and gladness.  #explore #12tribes #unity #peace #joy
cleanTitle: The Carolinas came together with joyfulness and gladness.
segments: Hey, Shalom Israel, Most High Christ
bless officer attorney here at the
Pentecost in Greensboro, North Carolina.
As you can see, the people or the food
is being served [music and singing] over
here. We got our leadership behind us.
Everybody is enjoying themselves, having
a good time. I'm a member of the admin
team, as you can see, event staff. When
we came here, as you can see, there's
tables, chairs, and  set up. None
of this was [singing] done before we got
here. Everybody is enjoying themselves.
We going to continue this. Bishop's
[music and singing] class is getting
ready to come up. After Bishop's class
goes off, we're going to turn the music
on. We're going  to party and
have a good time to close out the feast.
Wish y'all were here. Don't miss it next
year.  We'll see you then. Most
High Christ bless.
